# Does patient financing pay for its merchant fee, or should we carry the payment plan ourselves?

> Free calculator for dental and orthodontic practices: third-party patient financing vs an in-house payment plan vs pay-in-full. What you keep per case after merchant fees, defaults and waiting, and the acceptance rate financing must reach to pay for itself. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
